segments.text: IIT Madras just announced something no Indian university [music] has ever done before. They're going multinational. Some of India's most cuttingedge [music]
tech startups were born here. Aether Energy, India's leading electric scooter company. Agnicle Cosmos on track to become [music] India's first private
orbital rocket launch company. Planis Technologies, [music] one of India's most advanced underwater robotics startups. These companies didn't just
grow fast, they outgrew India. So IIT Madras is building infrastructure to follow them. They're calling it IITM
global [music] and they've already signed across the US, UK, Germany, Dubai, Singapore [music] and Malaysia.
Now global expansion sounds like marketing. So here's what they're actually doing. First, transferring IIT Madras research into global markets.
Second, [music] bringing international industry problems directly to IITM faculty. Third, helping IIT startups enter global ecosystems faster. Fourth,
attracting foreign capital into Indian deep tech. The [music] real question is whether it can make Indian education truly mainstream on a global level.
